title: Sequential weak compactness of currents in ℝ^P with locally bounded mass
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let T_j ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), j ∈ ℕ, satisfy sup_j M_{ball(0,R)}(T_j) < ∞ in [0, ∞] for every R ∈ ℝ (SimonGMT massOn, Euclidean coefficient norm). Then there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) such that T_{φ(i)} ⇀ C, i.e. T_{φ(i)}(ω) → C(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (WeaklyConvergesOn).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (T : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ R : ℝ, ⨆ j, (T j).massOn (ball (0 : Euclid P) R) < ∞) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), StrictMono φ ∧ WeaklyConvergesOn (fun i => T (φ i)) C
